doc: docs/rescue-locator/pole-widzenia.md, section 'Wagi śladów: wiarygodność i zanik w czasie' (sources [1]-[25]); values from clue-weights.proposal.json (AI Michała, f5aeadf). Contract: rescue/app/CONTRACT.md 'Clue weights'. Engine: RescueKit/ClueWeights.swift (Swift defaults = this file).
formula: weight = sources[source] * accuracy(type) * 0.5^(ageH / halfLifeH) * corroboration, clamped to 0..1; accuracy = clamp((accuracy.refM / accuracyM)^accuracy.exponent, accuracy.min, 1); halfLifeH null = no decay. The clue's map layer enters as layer^weight (1 = full effect as before, 0 = none). Operator override replaces the weight.
note: Illustrative defaults, not TOPR/GOPR procedures. 'est' = estimate without a direct source.

przeszukanie.label: Przeszukanie bez wyniku
przeszukanie.note: est; negative evidence: layer (1 - POD)^weight; decays like a rescuer report (the person may walk into a searched segment)

clueTypes.about: POST /api/clue type and the engine's event classes -> type above

accuracy.note: est; 100 m or better = 1, 200 m 0.78, 500 m 0.57, 5 km 0.4 (floor)

recency.note: decay 0.5^(ageH / halfLifeH) as in the proposal; floor > 0 keeps a residual weight

corroboration.note: est; agree = independent clues (different source or team) within max(radiusM, 0.8 x the larger radius) and observation gap <= the shorter halfLife: x agreeBoost each, max agreeBoostMax. conflict = observed within the shorter halfLife but farther apart than maxSubjectSpeedKmh allows (+ mean radius) from a clue of higher base weight: x conflictPenalty each. searchedPenalty (est, engine extension): a no-find search of the clue's segment after the observation. Operator override always wins.

scentHalfLifeMultipliers.note: est; from the proposal, not applied by the engine yet
